name: control-hostkey-changed
description: A target presenting a host key other than the recorded one is refused: error hostkey_changed, before any connected, naming both fingerprints. Accept-on-first-use never extends to a changed key; the core answers the session create 409 hostkey_changed. A collected run (the harness's host-key rig) must show one, and no connected after it.

msg.message: host key changed: recorded SHA256:FIXTURE111111111111111111111111111111111111, presented SHA256:FIXTURE000000000000000000000000000000000000; refused
